statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Cardiac event monitoring with CPT 93271 was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias
The service was ordered to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-97
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
